findings.summary: Candidate discovery recursively searches using the configured patterns and excludes paths whose parts contain .git.

The executor recursively walks ROOT, skips .git and selected preserved prefixes, then marks paths for deletion when they match any configured prefix, suffix, or name substring. Its deletion helper uses shutil.rmtree for directories and Path.unlink for files; it does not request per-item confirmation.

candidate_generator.summary: Candidate discovery recursively searches using the configured patterns and excludes paths whose parts contain .git.

cleanup_executor.summary: The executor recursively walks ROOT, skips .git and selected preserved prefixes, then marks paths for deletion when they match any configured prefix, suffix, or name substring. Its deletion helper uses shutil.rmtree for directories and Path.unlink for files; it does not request per-item confirmation.
